Create a new aspect-ratio adaptation of the approved cover in image 1. This is a genuinely newly composed layout, NOT a stretched or cropped version. Keep its bright editorial magazine art direction: warm ivory lightly textured paper, charcoal-black heavy Chinese typography, vivid cobalt blue highlight blocks and brush marks, coral-orange AI subtitle, slightly tilted white rounded browser frames with soft realistic shadows. Image 1 is the approved style/copy target; image 2 is the actual dashboard supporting insert; image 3 is the actual green-bubble customer matrix supporting insert. Preserve recognizable cream interface, KPI cards, colorful ring charts, and green bubble customer chart; avoid illegible invented UI if possible. Keep entire browser-frame edges and important business figures inside the canvas. No people are needed. All four overlay text strings MUST be exact and fully legible: "广告公司要失业了？", "AI 一次直出宣传片", "个人订单驾驶舱", "项目作者：Jed杰德哥". Capital J, lowercase ed. The hook is the largest type, black with "失业了？" in white on cobalt. AI subtitle coral-orange. Project name is another LARGE bold white-on-blue title, approximately 80–100% of AI subtitle size, NOT a tiny badge. Author is smaller dark-blue text, around 25% of the project title font height, but clearly legible. Can introduce line breaks within the hook and subtitle to fit this ratio, but do not change any word or add words. Project name preferably one full line; if required break it as "个人订单" / "驾驶舱" using equally large text. All type should have strong clear hierarchy. No added GPT/model name, no watermark, no extra marketing phrases, no platform logos. At least 7% side and top safe margin, at least 8% bottom margin for all text; for portrait, respect the larger bottom safe zone requested below. Important objects complete and inside bounds. No letters hanging over edges. Composition should be elegant but highly attention-grabbing at mobile thumbnail size.
